title: Trump seeks 10% cap on credit card interest rates with Democrats' support
description:
President Donald Trump said Saturday that he would work with the incoming Democratic Congress to cap credit card interest rates, hoping to fulfill a promise he made on the 2024 campaign trail but couldn't deliver on because of industry pressure and a lack of interest from his fellow Republicans.
"I would do it. These credit card companies have made a lot," Trump told Fox News Channel's "Saturday in America."
Democrats and the Republican president have both backed capping credit card interest rates, with the standard proposal being capping rates at 10 per cent. It would substantially reduce what credit card companies can charge customers. The median credit card interest rate is roughly 22.2 per cent, according to an August survey by the New York Federal Reserve.
